_notes: A1 — License, serial number, and user setup, steps 4-5 (catalog A1, plan test-plans/journey-a/a01-user-setup.md, recording docs/media/journey-a/a01-user-setup.mp4, runner row A1): create an office user with a role and per-user permissions, verify it in the Users list, open it for edit, deactivate it. Runs logged in via .auth/user.json; the login half is tests/web/system/login-module.spec.ts.

One happy-path case per spec, flat (no cases wrapper). user holds the New User form values the case types; the run-unique Name/Initials/Email and the password come from src/data/generated (makeUser) through src/utils/journeys/journeyAFlow.ts — the name prefix is the residue sweep's own for users (cleanupTargets.ts, 'QA User '), so what the factory names the sweep can always find.

PET Tiger has no delete-user action in the UI, so teardown removes users through DELETE /users/{id} (WEBPET-1606). A1 deactivates its user as a STEP (the only retire action the screen offers); the delete step is teardown.

screen.roles is every Role option the New User form offers, in the order the UI lists them (order-sensitive: a case asserting the dropdown with toHaveText(roles) doubles as a guard against an option being added, removed or reordered). screen.messages are the form's toasts. Reference data the current case uses neither of, kept for the screen's record.
